short: A Self-Regulated Interface toward Highly Reversible Aqueous
title: A Self-Regulated Interface toward Highly Reversible Aqueous Zinc Batteries

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Zn metal anodes in aqueous Zn batteries suffer dendrite growth and side reactions (corrosion, H2 evolution), limiting reversibility. One additive supplying a competing cation and a pH-buffering anion should suppress dendrites and corrosion at once.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/modification), n4 (DES/variable_sweep), n5 (PRC/stimulus)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Zn deposits compact and free of protruding dendrite flakes in NH4OAc electrolyte, vs disordered flakes in blank. Insoluble ZHSH (Zn4SO4(OH)6·4H2O) by-product is absent from Zn anodes cycled with NH4OAc, unlike blank

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: NH4+ adsorbs on Zn preferentially over Zn2+, forming an electrostatic shield that prevents agglomerated Zn deposition. OAc-/HOAc pair neutralises locally generated OH-, holding interfacial pH steady near ~5.3 instead of climbing to ~7.5.
states.detail: Absorbed: n6 (MEC/pathway), n8 (MEC/pathway), n12 (PRP/value). Premises: Competing cations adsorbed on Zn tips repel incoming Zn2+ (electrostatic shielding), reported earlier; Acetic acid/acetate is a weak-acid buffer pair (pKa ~4.76) that neutralises added OH- and H+

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Zn//Zn symmetric cell with NH4OAc cycles 3500 h at 1 mA cm-2, 1 mAh cm-2, about ten times the blank. Zn//Od-NVO full cell with NH4OAc keeps 83.7% capacity after 500 cycles at 1 A g-1, vs 32.2% with blank

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: NH4OAc builds a self-regulated Zn/electrolyte interface (NH4+ shielding plus OAc- pH buffer) giving dendrite- and by-product-free, highly reversible Zn anodes compatible with an Od-NVO cathode
